title: Balancing AI tensions: Moving from AI adoption to effective SDLC use
attributed_claim_summary: DORA's research synthesis describes associations between greater AI use and both software-delivery throughput and instability; creation effort may shift into review and verification.
evidence_or_event: Original DORA March 2026 analysis interpreting its 2025 state-of-AI-assisted-software-development report and qualitative material.
limitations: Organizational associations and selected qualitative material cannot identify causal effects for a particular GitHub repo or agent; measures and sampling differ from prospective user-task trials.
research_relevance: Test productivity with complete planning, reviewer, CI, rework and incident costs, not generated LOC or number of PRs.
practical_experiment: Define an opt-in task-level ledger covering planning, independent review, CI, follow-up failures and accepted completions; compare complete rather than code-writing effort.
